title: Intake
description: Five-question intake elicited from the user before audit begins. Drives stage routing, severity weighting, and tool selection.

document_type.description: Document type drives parsing strategy and severity weighting.

document_type_other.description: Free-text label; required when document_type == 'other'. Business rule enforced in validate_intake.py.

sources_available.description: Determines whether Stage 3 alignment can be performed and which Stage 4 routing path applies.

verification_tier.description: Tier 1 = citation existence only; Tier 2 = + alignment; Tier 3 = full audit; custom = user-specified checks_enabled.

checks_enabled.description: Required when verification_tier == 'custom'. Computed from tier otherwise. prose_quality_audit writes style_findings[] (§STYLE_NONCONFORMING); figure_integrity_audit writes figure_findings[] (§FIGURE_INTEGRITY) — both parallel pipelines, custom-only, never auto-included by a numbered tier. Business rule enforced in validate_intake.py.

domain.description: Selects connector priority list (PubMed-first vs Crossref-first).

flag_threshold.description: Conservative: only verified disagreements; standard: per matrix; strict: also flag single-source weak claims.

cited_papers.description: Optional. Pointers to artifacts produced by upstream research-paper-summarizer runs for cited sources. When present, Stage 6 (numerical sanity) joins the document's numerical claims against each entry's stats.json by paper_id, eliminating re-extraction of cited-paper numbers. When absent or when an entry's validate_stats.py fails, Stage 6 falls back to full-text re-extraction. The orchestrator populates this from each summarizer fork-return's summary_paths.{stats,source_meta}; canonical shape mirrored from verifier_kit/schemas/intake.base.json#/$defs/citedPaper (inlined per project convention — see audit_report.json Finding).

pinned_sidecars.description: Optional. Pointers to deep-research sidecar artifacts when the document under review is the markdown report produced by the deep-research skill. When present, the verifier activates *diff-mode* on Stage 3 (claim-citation alignment): in addition to re-fetching cited sources from the web, the verifier diffs report claims against the sidecar values and emits DRIFT_FROM_SIDECAR findings for any mismatch. See references/CONTRACTS.md §Deep-research handoff. The orchestrator populates this from the report's `<!-- evidence_pinned: ... -->` marker plus the conventional sibling filenames; see deep-research/SKILL.md §Evidence Pinning.

grading_path.description: Path to {date}_{topic_slug}_{mode}_grading.json. Required for verification-status / T-tier drift detection.

synthesis_path.description: Path to {date}_{topic_slug}_{mode}_synthesis.json. Required for theme / gap / contradiction drift detection.

advocate_path.description: Path to {date}_{topic_slug}_{mode}_advocate.json. Required for open-CRITICAL-finding suppression detection.

CitedPaper.description: Pointer to artifacts emitted by an upstream summarizer (research-paper-summarizer fork-return summary_paths). Mirrors verifier_kit/schemas/intake.base.json#/$defs/citedPaper.

paper_id.description: Stable identifier shared by stats.json (top-level paper_id) and source_meta.json (top-level paper_id). Join key for Stage 6 evidence pinning. Note: stats.json claims have claim_id, not paper_id — paper_id lives at the file root.
